name: InboXo
oneLiner: A disposable email inbox that lives in your browser toolbar
description:
- Built a browser extension using Plasmo, React, and TypeScript for instant disposable email management
- Implemented live inbox polling and background alarms to track unread messages on the toolbar badge
- Designed dual reading modes featuring a compact popup reader and a full-page two-pane inbox
- Ensured secure email rendering by isolating message bodies inside a sandboxed iframe with scripts disabled
- Integrated mail.tm API for automated mailbox provisioning, custom attachments, and session persistence

name: File Storage App
oneLiner: Manage files and folders with roles, analytics, and admin controls
description:
- Built a full-featured file storage system using Next.js and TypeScript
- Implemented authentication and role-based access with BetterAuth
- Designed scalable backend with DrizzleKit ORM and AWS S3 for file storage
- Added analytics, admin dashboards, and user role management
- Developed clean UI using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI components

name: aces-website
oneLiner: Official website for ACES with event and member management
description:
- Developed backend infrastructure for ACES official website
- Managed events, member profiles, and resource sharing
- Focused on scalability and clean API design

name: student-tiffin
